doc.name: Brainy Prices
doc.instructions: For a direct question, call the matching tool (e.g. housing_rents, schools, grocery_products or fuel_prices). Use start_here only if unsure which tool to use. Cite source, licence, date and open_in_browser. Preserve historical periods and original labels. Paused sources must not be retried. Unknown values stay null; a partial subtotal is not a complete budget. Separate observed groceries, ministry_shop_prices MOET references, community reports and estimates. Tools are read-only: no purchases, accounts, enrollment or contact. Ask for missing personal assumptions; For end_of_service_gratuity and labour_calculator, supply basic wage and employment dates privately; estimate, not legal advice. Do not put salary or employment dates in URLs or logs. Request data pages only when needed for the user question; never export datasets.

tools.name: commute_cost
tools.description: Monthly/annual car commute cost (fuel+Salik), or published area routes. No parking.

tools.name: costs_by_area
tools.description: Dubai areas ranked by monthly cost: rent, fees, bills (+school). Not full budgets.

tools.name: costs_by_emirate
tools.description: Compare emirates: rent, utilities, schools. Non-Dubai rent unknown.

tools.name: data_sources
tools.description: Where each number comes from: publishers, licences, dates, paused sources.

tools.name: dewa
tools.description: DEWA electricity/water: tariff slabs, or bill estimate from kwh (+water, VAT, fee).

tools.name: end_of_service_gratuity
tools.description: UAE private-sector end-of-service gratuity estimate (Decree-Law 33/2021 art. 51): basic wage + dates → amount or range; not legal advice.

tools.name: fixed_monthly_costs
tools.description: Monthly fixed costs for a household profile, with assumptions. Not a full budget.

use_condition.const: Do not show this figure with affiliate links, store recommendations or a shopping cart (FAO additional terms of use).

tools.name: free_zone_companies
tools.description: Free zone company setup: package prices, annual/monthly cost, visas.

tools.name: fuel_prices
tools.description: UAE petrol/diesel prices this month and last, change, 50/70 L tank cost, history.

tools.name: fx_rates
tools.description: Dated ECB-based AED FX rates. Not bank quotes.

tools.name: grocery_compare_list
tools.description: Cheapest store for a list: subtotals, delivery fees, minimums. items: ["milk"]. Observed + labelled estimates.

estimated_label.const: items not priced at this store — estimated generic price

tools.name: grocery_products
tools.description: Dubai supermarket prices: per-store pack/unit offers, dates, history. Give query (product name), e.g. milk, or product_id. Not MOET.

tools.name: grocery_stores
tools.description: Grocery stores: delivery fees, free-delivery thresholds, minimum orders.

tools.name: health_insurance
tools.description: Dubai health insurance rules: who pays, basic plan band/benefits, fines. Not quotes.

tools.name: housing_rents
tools.description: Registered Dubai rent: annual/monthly medians, contract counts. zone or q: JVC. Not listings.

tools.name: housing_sales
tools.description: Sale prices by Dubai area: ready/off-plan registered medians. Not listings.

tools.name: labour_calculator
tools.description: UAE labour law estimates (Decree-Law 33/2021): overtime pay, annual leave, final settlement. Not legal advice.

tools.name: ministry_shop_prices
tools.description: MOET-published Dubai shop prices. category: bread or chain_id/product_id. Not online offers.

tools.name: mobile_internet_plans
tools.description: UAE mobile and home internet plans: VAT-inclusive price, data, contract.

tools.name: move_to_dubai
tools.description: Move to Dubai? Home vs Dubai net pay, taxes, FX, costs, savings. No country: models. Owner: household=business_owner + profit. Not tax advice.

use_condition.const: Do not show this figure with affiliate links, store recommendations or a shopping cart (FAO additional terms of use).

tools.name: residence_visas
tools.description: UAE residence visas by route: payer, requirements, fees, medical/insurance bands.

tools.name: schools
tools.description: Dubai school fees: KHDA tuition by grade/year, bus fees, distance. q: school name; near: zone (JVC). Year ≠ Grade; uniforms paused.

q.description: school name or part of it

tools.name: shopper_price_reports
tools.description: Community price reports by product/store, with date and promos.

tools.name: start_here
tools.description: Tool selection help: examples and citations.

tools.name: tax_savings_by_country
tools.description: Tax saved by moving to Dubai, per country, typical pay. Not tax advice.

tools.name: transport_fares
tools.description: Taxi fare estimate, or metro/bus fares, parking and toll tariffs. Not app quotes.

prompts.name: check_sources
prompts.description: Inspect metadata, methods and source permissions for a topic without downloading its dataset.

prompts.name: compare_areas
prompts.description: Compare fixed cost components for a supplied housing scenario without inventing rental coverage outside Dubai.

arguments.name: school_grade
arguments.description: Published schoolgrade; optional and no assumed child.

prompts.name: compare_grocery_list
prompts.description: Compare only the grocery items a user actually supplied; distinguish observed offers, official reference prices and buyer reports.

arguments.name: items
arguments.description: One supplied grocery item perline,1–40items, max120chars each.

prompts.name: compare_moving_from
prompts.description: Compare a supplied home-country salary scenario with Dubai, using dated tax, FX and partial costs; ask for missing personal assumptions.

arguments.name: origin_country
arguments.description: ISO2 or supported country name; never infer from language.

arguments.name: gross_annual
arguments.description: Positive annual gross in supplied currency, up to operation maximum; do not put in URLs.

arguments.name: household
arguments.description: JSON text containing only supplied status (single/married) and children (integer 0–10); ask before calculating defaults.

arguments.name: target_area
arguments.description: Dubai area identifier or name; optional registered housing query.

arguments.name: home_monthly_costs
arguments.description: Nonnegative monthly costs in supplied currency; omit if unknown.

prompts.name: school_shortlist
prompts.description: Shortlist nearby schools by the exact published Year/Grade label, historical tuition and approximate straight-line distance.

arguments.name: grade
arguments.description: Published grade label, max30; YEAR7 is not GRADE7.
